name: Anxious Black Girls Plus
tagline: More support, whenever you need it.

benefits.title: Every article, unlocked
benefits.text: All 106 articles across 20 topics, from anxiety and burnout to PCOS, motherhood and grief. Press play on the ones with audio.

benefits.title: The full Pocketbook
benefits.text: All 57 coping skills instead of 20. Something for the work meeting, the family group chat and the 2 a.m. spiral.

benefits.title: Watch it, then practice it
benefits.text: Short videos show each skill in a real moment. Then work through it step by step and save your practices.

benefits.title: Reminders that sound like a friend
benefits.text: Meds, water, meals, the text you keep leaving on read. Pick your times and snooze when life happens.

benefits.title: Support that stays in the community
benefits.text: Your subscription keeps a Black woman-owned mental health company going, and pays for new articles, audio and skills.
